note: A module with "home": false stays in the menu, plan and visibility lists but gets no tile on the Home page. A module with a "parent" is a sub-tab of that parent module: it keeps its own plan and visibility switch but is not listed separately on Home or the public landing page. Single source of truth for the side panel, the in-app Home page and the public landing page. Every domain is a single sidebar link (no expansion) that opens its own hub page; that hub page shows all of the domain's modules as tabs, with an Overview tab first. Add leaves inside existing domains; update status as features ship.
